response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems developer with strong open-source, DevOps, and mentoring experience, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: he lacks anything close to 8 years of C++ experience (only a brief ~6-month stint at National Instruments touches C/C++), his career has centered on web/product engineering (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than large-scale cloud compute infrastructure, and there's no evidence of production cloud-platform architecture or formal technical leadership over cloud/DevOps engineers at the required scale.
strengths: Broad, deep engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and distributed systems
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and community-building (workshops, talks, open-source founder)
Strong software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD, testing tools/frameworks he built himself)
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (well under the required 8 years) and not a recent or central focus
No clear track record with large-scale cloud compute platforms, distributed infrastructure, or hardware/storage architecture at required scale
No explicit experience leading or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineering teams in a formal technical leadership capacity

key_factors.factor: Lack of large-scale cloud/compute infrastructure background
Strong mentoring and technical leadership soft skills
